user_review.method: Follow-up to the executed Claude pilot (PR #2). Reproduced the missing transaction-note/copy-recovery contracts on verified 2026.9.20 source, then ran 63 deterministic tests on Linux/Python 3.13.5 (one Windows-only skip). This is code acceptance, not a new live-model, macOS-local or independent-subagent run. Trigger description is unchanged. Final CI exposed a test-only temporary-path alias mismatch on macOS and Windows; canonicalized both paths and added an assertion that the injected fault fires. Linux 63-test rerun passed; final cross-platform CI is a separate merge gate.

scenarios.request: Organize an asset and update the actual task notes, then undo the whole operation.
scenarios.expected: Preview does not write; the committed notes and moves restore together, including modes. Later independent edits still block rollback.
scenarios.observed: New notes use complete text plus expected_sha256. Integrated-note, stale-input, interruption and newer-edit assertions pass; no guard exclusions.

scenarios.request: Generate a recovery command for a disposable copy without writing to the original.
scenarios.expected: Explicitly selected copy identity and blobs validate, command generation is read-only, and rollback changes only the copy.
scenarios.observed: New recovery command passed copy isolation and wrong-task/corrupt-blob rejection assertions. The original snapshot remained unchanged.

similar_skills.learned: Separate exact snapshots and explicit application from semantic judgment; preserve package/work changes rather than bypassing protection.
similar_skills.reason: Reuse the same-day reviewed comparison (blob 836499a56bf7622b58f7d6636e06617f3b34b5d6). This follow-up keeps all conflict guards and adds only explicitly hashed notes to one operation.

similar_skills.learned: Resume one explicitly selected persisted task; reconcile work rather than guessing which path is authoritative.
similar_skills.reason: Reuse the same-day reviewed comparison (blob e13bd532ef7d6407f55b1ac34d8334c99cef4ee1). Copy recovery validates the selected task and does not silently redirect an old command.

validation.observed: Ran 63 tests; OK (skipped=1). All existing applicable tests and 11 new note/selected-copy cases pass on Linux. Skips are not additional passes.
VERDICT: PASS against the candidate documentation and unchanged product metadata.

limitations: No new authenticated model pilot or automatic routing result. The reported canonical routing miss remains unverified in this environment.
The new notes contract covers updates specified before apply; arbitrary subsequent edits remain conflicts. Old receipts cannot silently absorb new work.
